heading: NTPC vs NTPC Green Energy: Decoding Q2 FY27 Performance
tldr: NTPC reported a robust 38.7% year-on-year profit growth, reaching ₹7,029.56 crore for Q2 FY27.
Its subsidiary, NTPC Green Energy, also saw significant profit expansion, growing 59% to ₹137.50 crore.
NTPC announced its first interim dividend for investors, reflecting strong financial health.
While NTPC's absolute profit is substantially higher, NTPC Green Energy demonstrates faster percentage growth.
Investors should consider both the scale of the parent company and the rapid expansion of the green energy arm.
caption:
Ever wondered how big companies grow, and how their newer, greener parts perform? NTPC, a giant in power, just announced a big jump in profits. Its younger, green energy arm is growing even faster! This shows both steady growth from the parent and exciting speed from its new ventures. See the full story in our article.
